text:
The change spec sections (`header.json`, `units-001.json`, `units-002.json`, and `units-003.json`) have been updated and verified:

1. **Standard enumerable `textStyleRanges` property (`header.json`, `U02`–`U04`, `U06`, `U08`, `U11`, `U13`, `U14`, `U17`)**: Removed the non-enumerable hidden accessor (`attachTextStyleRanges`) and instead store `textStyleRanges` as a standard enumerable own property (`normalizeTextStyleRanges(...)`, defaulting to `[]`) on `ExcalidrawTextElement` across `newTextElement`, `restoreElement`, `deepCopyElement`, `ElementsDelta.applyDelta`, and all `newElementWith` / object-spread updates and JSON round-trips.
2. **Clipboard serialisation, parsing, and test coverage (`U15`, `U21`)**: Added `U15` (`packages/excalidraw/clipboard.ts`) to normalise and clone `textStyleRanges` (defaulting legacy text elements to `[]`) in both `serializeAsClipboardJSON` and `parseClipboard`, and expanded `U21` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx`) to explicitly test clipboard copy/paste (`FR-12`, `AC-6`).
